criteria.assertion: catalog verification and rejection require a recorded reason
incident submission requires the author and the current saved formulation digest
all stored attachments have sha256 and failed writes remove unreferenced files
audit chain is verifiable after restart
raw monitoring intent, contribution and incident intake persist when AI is unavailable
failed planning, contribution enrichment and incident analysis can be retried without duplicating raw input
only active monitoring missions run automatically
draft, paused or failed planning can be revised and re-planned with history
active monitoring can be paused with a reason and resumed
repeated discovery appends observations instead of erasing origin history
incident draft is blocked while justified questions remain
incident formulation must be versioned before submission
users see only their incident and contribution material
evidence downloads carry the active actor and role
no new experience invariant appears in M+100 scenarios
no new observed runtime primitive appears in N+50 scenarios
